title: 第110章 给点利息第109章 真乖
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
谢云开没有看他，低头看了那块留影石片刻，然后把灵力注了进去。
石面在他灵力触及的瞬间亮起一层柔和的灰白色光芒，光芒在石面上方凝成一个画面。
御兽宗的后山，那个他当年采药时走过的岩洞入口，日光正从树梢上方斜斜地照下来，他背着竹篓走进去的背影在画面边缘一闪而过。
画面在洞口的石壁前停住了，然后视角开始移动，像是在跟随着某个人的脚步穿过走廊，最终停在了一间他从未进去过的库房前面。
那扇门被推开了，一只穿着深紫色锦袍袖口的手探了进去，在库房内侧的格架上摸索了一下，抽走了样东西，然后门重新合上了。
那只手收回来的角度和袖口的纹路清清楚楚的，深紫色的锦缎料子在画面中停留了足够长的一瞬，长到任何人都能认出那件衣袍和坐在御兽宗正堂中央的那个人身上穿着的是同一件。
谢云开的手在微微发抖，他低头看着那个画面，那只深紫色袖口的手从格架上抽走样东西的动作，然后画面在那个点上静止了。
他的呼吸在那一瞬间停了一拍，然后他慢慢地抬起头来，目光从手中的留影石移到面前的宗主脸上，嘴唇动了一下，声音哑得几乎听不清：“……是你。“
宗主的脸色在谢云开抬头看向他的那一瞬间白了。
他张着嘴想要说什么，可喉咙上的禁制依然封着他所有想要出口的声音。
他扶着椅子的扶手想要站起来，可他的腿使不上力，整个人在椅子上晃了一下，又重新跌坐回去，手指攥着扶手边缘攥得指节发白。
江欲站在旁边，看了一眼谢云开手中的留影石，又看了一眼宗主那张已经完全失色的脸。
下一秒她的掌心朝上，一道灵力从她掌心涌出，在半空中化作一片扩散开来的光晕，那道光晕像是一只无形的喇叭口一样，她的声音通过那层灵力扩散出去，清清楚楚地落进了整个御兽宗的每一个角落：“所有御兽宗弟子，到正堂来。“
她的声音在大半个时辰之后那些弟子们便陆陆续续地涌进了正堂。
有的还穿着训练服，袖口卷着，手里攥着半截没系好的缰绳，揉着自己还酸着的肩膀，目光带着一种“又要干什么“的警惕和不耐。
他们进来之后看到的第一样东西，是站在正堂中央手里握着一块已经亮起画面的留影石的谢云开。
他的衣袍上还带着灰痕，额角的青紫没有消，手指在微微发颤，可他站在那里手没有垂下。
人群里响起了一阵嗡嗡的议论声。
“谢云开？他怎么还在？“
“他手里拿的什么？“

“他怎么又回来了……宗主不是说了他不能进御兽宗的地界吗？“
“身上还带着伤，刚才不会真打起来了吧？“
那几个方才在门口嘲讽过他的外门弟子站在前排，抱着胳膊嘴角弯着那副惯常的弧度。
“哟，还在呢？拿了块破石头站在这儿，是要给谁看——“
他的声音在目光落在那块留影石上方的画面时断掉了。
画面里那只深紫色的袖口正在格架上摸索，袖口边缘的银丝绣纹清清楚楚的。
content_en:
Xie Yunkai didn't look at him, he looked down at the image stone for a moment, and then poured his spiritual energy into it.
The stone surface lit up with a layer of soft gray-white light the moment his spiritual power touched it, and the light condensed into a picture on the stone surface.
In the back mountain of Yushou Sect, the entrance of the cave that he walked through when collecting herbs, the sun was shining slanting down from above the treetops, and his back walking in with a bamboo basket on his back flashed past the edge of the picture.
The screen stopped in front of the stone wall at the entrance of the cave, and then the perspective began to move, as if following someone's footsteps through the corridor, and finally stopped in front of a warehouse that he had never entered.
The door was pushed open, and a hand wearing the cuff of a dark purple brocade robe reached in, groped on the rack inside the warehouse, took something away, and then closed the door again.
The angle of the hand's retraction and the lines of the cuffs were clear. The dark purple brocade material stayed in the picture for a moment long enough for anyone to recognize that the robe was the same one worn by the man sitting in the center of the Beast Control Sect's main hall.
Xie Yunkai's hands were trembling slightly. He looked down at the picture. The hand with the dark purple cuff was pulling something away from the shelf, and then the picture stopped at that point.
His breathing paused for a moment, then he slowly raised his head, his eyes moved from the photo stone in his hand to the face of the sect master in front of him, his lips moved, and his voice was so hoarse that he could barely hear it: "...it's you."
The sect leader's face turned pale the moment Xie Yunkai raised his head and looked at him.
He opened his mouth to say something, but the restriction in his throat still blocked all the sounds he wanted to make.
He held on to the armrests of the chair and tried to stand up, but his legs failed him. He swayed on the chair, then fell back down again. His fingers clenched the edges of the armrests until his knuckles turned white.
Jiang Yu stood aside and glanced at the photo stone in Xie Yunkai's hand, and then at the sect leader's face that had completely lost its color.
The next second she turned her palm upward, and a stream of spiritual power surged out from her palm, turning into a spreading halo in mid-air. The halo was like an invisible trumpet. Her voice spread out through that layer of spiritual power and fell clearly into every corner of the entire Beast Control Sect: "All Beast Control Sect disciples, come to the main hall."
After her voice, more than half an hour later, the disciples poured into the main hall one after another.
Some were still wearing training clothes, with their cuffs rolled up, holding half of the untied reins in their hands, rubbing their still sore shoulders, with a vigilance and impatience in their eyes that said "What are we going to do again?"
The first thing they saw after they came in was Xie Yunkai standing in the center of the main hall holding a picture stone that had already lit up.
There were still gray marks on his robe, the bruise on his forehead was still there, and his fingers were trembling slightly, but he stood there without lowering his hands.
There was a buzz of discussion in the crowd.
"Xie Yunkai? Why is he still here?"
"What's he holding?"
"Why is he back again...Didn't the sect leader say that he cannot enter the realm of the Beast Control Sect?"
"You're still injured. You didn't really get into a fight just now, did you?"
The few outer disciples who had just mocked him at the door were standing in the front row, with their arms folded and the corners of their mouths curved in the usual curve.
"Hey, you're still there? You're standing here with a broken stone. Who are you trying to show it to-"
His voice broke off when his eyes fell on the image above the image stone.
In the picture, the dark purple cuff is groping on the grid, and the silver embroidery pattern on the edge of the cuff is clear.
